home.metaTitle: RigLog — build tracker, restoration journal & repair log
home.heroTitle: Every bolt, every lei, every photo — in one place.
home.heroBody: RigLog is a build tracker for off-road rigs, a restoration journal for classics, and a repair log for the car you drive every day. Keep the history your vehicle deserves.
home.noCard: One vehicle free, forever. No card needed to start.
home.foundingHeadline: Founding members get Pro free for life.
home.modesTitle: Pick the mode that fits the vehicle
home.featuresTitle: Built for the way people actually work on cars
home.pricingTitle: Free to start, Pro when you outgrow it
home.proAnalytics: Full cost analytics, charts and trends
home.proExtras: Trail log, VIN decoder, originality score
home.proAlsoAvailable: Also available annually ({annual} RON) or as a one-off lifetime purchase ({lifetime} RON).
home.proFoundingNote: The first {limit} accounts pay none of it — {remaining} still open.
home.communityTitle: Help decide what gets built next
home.roadmapBody: Report a bug or request a feature, then vote on what other people have asked for. The most wanted rises to the top, and you can see what is planned or already in progress.
home.supportBody: RigLog is small and self-funded. If it has saved you a spreadsheet or two, a one-off contribution helps cover hosting and keeps the free tier free.
home.closingTitle: Start the logbook you wish you had
home.closingBody: It takes a minute to add your vehicle and your first job. Everything stays private until you decide otherwise.

OFFROAD.headline: Every mod, logged
OFFROAD.body: Lift kits, winches, lights, armour — what you fitted, what it cost, and what it looked like going on. Plus a GPS trail log for where it has actually been.

RESTORATION.headline: From barn find to finished
RESTORATION.body: Record the found state, then track every stage through to complete. Originality scoring and a VIN decoder help you keep a period-correct build honest.

DAILY_DRIVER.headline: What you fixed, what is due
DAILY_DRIVER.body: Servicing, brakes, tyres, ITP — a straight repair history for the car you actually drive. No project to finish, just a record worth having at resale.

costs.title: Real cost tracking
costs.body: Split parts from labour, DIY from workshop. See what the build has actually cost you, per category and over time.

photos.title: Photos on every job
photos.body: Before, after, and the bit in between. Compressed on upload, kept private unless you publish the build.

documents.title: Document reminders
documents.body: ITP, RCA, CASCO and rovinietă expiries, with email reminders at 30, 14 and 3 days. Historic vehicles are flagged automatically.

mechanic.title: Your mechanic can help
mechanic.body: Invite a mechanic or specialist to log their own work. They see the build, not your costs, if you would rather keep those private.

receipts.title: Receipts and PDF export
receipts.body: Attach receipts to any job, then export the whole history as a PDF — useful when the car changes hands.

privacy.title: Share it, or do not
privacy.body: Every project is private by default. Publish it when you want a public page, a shareable card, and a spot in the community feed.

home.metaDescription: Log every modification, restoration stage and repair on your vehicle: costs, photos, receipts and document reminders, in one place. Free to start.
